title: Playable slice — systemic life sim (AI-assisted build; downtown Lexington)
author: Fun-Tone-9333
selftext:
Free Windows playable slice of LifeSim.

Systemic life sim: downtown Lexington you can walk, Unreal (SM6 / Nanite / Lumen), 24 people on their own schedules, nothing scripted. Monday start; $200 in hand; $240 rent due in a week.

AI disclosure (same as itch): AI Assisted — Code, Graphics, Sounds, Text. Not claiming a specific model or “fully AI-made.”

Not the finished city. No fake crowds / real brands.

[https://durtedame.itch.io/lifesim](https://durtedame.itch.io/lifesim) — unzip → Play-LifeSim.bat (\~5.9 GB)

comments.author: Fun-Tone-9333
comments.body: Systemic life sim: downtown Lexington walk in Unreal (SM6 / Nanite / Lumen), with 24 people on their own schedules. Unzip the Windows build, then Play-LifeSim.bat (\~5.9 GB); dedicated GPU recommended, and if SmartScreen blocks an unsigned build: More info → Run anyway.

comments.body:

I’m not running a bat file and bypassing smart screen, especially when the description feels spammy and there’s only one vague image…

replies.author: Fun-Tone-9333
replies.body:
\*\*First run\*\*  
Windows. Install with the itch app (https://itch.io/app), then open LifeSim from your library. Dedicated GPU recommended.

\*\*Install instructions\*\*  
Install the itch app from https://itch.io/app, then install LifeSim from this page.
